Hi Elena — thanks for the detailed questions. I pulled together the factual answers below (copied from our internal SOP where relevant). Please see attached policy and SOP stubs.

Quoted for context:
> The sample looks good; can you confirm how you handle tenant scoping on hosted instances?

- Tenant scoping (hosted): every audit event is tagged with tenant_id and stored in a tenant-scoped index. Our export tooling filters by tenant_id at query-time and validates tenant isolation before generating any export artifact. We never include events from other tenants in a tenant-scoped export.

> For the export mechanism: does Redwood issue time-limited pre-signed S3 URLs for customers, or do exports flow to Redwood-managed storage and are provided by support as a manual deliverable?

- Export options (hosted):
  * Self-serve through the Console: customers on Dedicated and Private can generate exports directly to a customer-configured S3 bucket via a presigned-write flow (time-limited).
  * Hosted customers: we provide a secure, tenant-scoped export delivered via a presigned S3 download URL. By default exports are generated by our jobs and stored encrypted at rest for 7 days; the presigned URL is issued for 72 hours.
  * For very large exports or for customers on compliance plans, we can deliver a server-to-server transfer to a customer S3 via an authenticated, one-time push and rotate keys.

> Retention: are retention defaults configurable per-account?

- Retention defaults:
  * Default hosted retention: 90 days for inference and auth events, 365 days for admin/config-change events.
  * Configurable tiers: customers can request retention increases for hosted under an add-on (up to 36 months) or configure retention directly in Dedicated/Private deployments.
  * Immutability: we support WORM-like retention for Dedicated/Private upon customer request and contract.

Evidence we can provide immediately: redacted audit-log sample (attached), log-retention-policy.pdf (attached), and an operational SOP (audit-log-sop.md) describing export verification and approval steps.

Next steps:
- I can prepare a one-page export-and-retention statement (suitable for procurement) by EOD tomorrow.
- If useful, schedule the 30-min handoff Thursday — Rachel, can you propose times?

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
